messages.content: Compare the Friday-evening and Saturday-morning Maine options for all three of us. Include bags, the extra Portland night, actual usable time, and both Sunday returns. I want one flight set to carry into hotels and a rental car, but do not book anything.
I’ll compare July 10-19 against July 11-19. Before I total it, should I assume one checked bag per person and that the Friday airport hotel is only for that arrival night?
Yes. Three checked bags each direction. Friday would be one night near PWM, then eight nights on the coast. Saturday would be eight nights total.

The Friday itinerary leaves ORD at 6:05 p.m., connects in Washington National for 58 minutes, and reaches Portland at 10:52 p.m. The round-trip fare for three is $1,188. Checked bags add $240, so flights plus bags are $1,428. A cancellable airport hotel with tax is about $246, bringing that date combination to $1,674 before the coastal lodging and rental car.
What does that arrival really look like? We will not be walking into the hotel at 10:55.

With checked bags, a realistic hotel arrival is 11:35 p.m. to midnight. That assumes 20-35 minutes for baggage and 15-25 minutes for the hotel shuttle or a short rideshare. I would not collect the rental car that night. Returning to PWM Saturday morning for an 8:30 a.m. pickup should put you on the road around 9:00.

The Saturday nonstop leaves ORD at 8:10 a.m. and arrives PWM at 11:33 a.m. Its round-trip fare is $1,422 for three; bags again add $240, for $1,662. There is no Portland hotel night, so it is $12 less than the Friday plan on the currently measurable travel costs, despite the airfare itself being $234 higher.
How much Saturday do we lose in practical terms? We are thinking Portland first, then driving south before turning up the coast later.

On Friday travel, you can have breakfast, retrieve the car, and be in central Portland around 9:15 a.m. After a few hours there, you could start south around lunch and reach the Kennebunkport area in roughly 45-60 minutes depending on traffic. With the Saturday nonstop, baggage and the rental counter likely put you in the car between 12:25 and 1:00 p.m. Central Portland would be about 1:15, or Kennebunkport about 1:45-2:15 if you drive there directly. The Friday option effectively buys four to five useful daytime hours.
Lay out the Sunday choices. I do not want the comparison quietly using different returns.

Using the same return for either outbound: the earlier nonstop leaves PWM Sunday at 1:25 p.m. and reaches ORD at 3:18 p.m.; it is included in the totals already quoted. The later option leaves at 5:40 p.m., connects at Dulles for 1 hour 5 minutes, and arrives ORD at 9:22 p.m. It adds $168 for three, making Friday $1,842 with the airport hotel or Saturday $1,830 without it.
How much usable time does the later return actually add once we allow for the airport?

About four hours. For the 1:25 nonstop, I would target PWM by 11:25 a.m.; for the 5:40 departure, by 3:40 p.m. The later flight adds 4 hours 15 minutes before airport arrival, but it also adds a connection, $168, and an ORD arrival just after 9:00 p.m. instead of midafternoon.

Use Friday evening outbound and the 1:25 nonstop home as the working flights. The $12 is immaterial compared with getting Saturday back, and I do not want to spend Sunday evening connecting. Recap what should feed the lodging and car search.

Working plan, entirely unbooked: Friday, July 10, depart ORD at 6:05 p.m., connect at DCA for 58 minutes, and arrive PWM at 10:52 p.m. Plan on reaching the airport hotel around 11:35 p.m. to midnight. The three round-trip fares are $1,188 and six checked-bag charges total $240. Add the estimated $246 cancellable Portland airport hotel for a current travel subtotal of $1,674. Saturday, July 11, return to PWM for an 8:30 a.m. rental pickup and expect to be driving around 9:00; that preserves a Portland morning and an early-afternoon drive south. Coastal lodging must cover eight nights, July 11-19, while the complete trip requires nine lodging nights including July 10 near PWM. Sunday, July 19, return the car and reach PWM by about 11:25 a.m. for the 1:25 p.m. nonstop, arriving ORD at 3:18 p.m. Use these flights and timing assumptions for the route, lodging, and rental-car comparison. Nothing has been booked.
